Vikunja server version is v0.24.6; webhooks_enabled=true; caldav_enabled=true; registration_enabled=true

Task schema confirmed: id (int, immutable), identifier (string, project-scoped e.g. #1), done (bool), done_at (ISO scalar), due_date (ISO), updated (ISO), created_by.username, project_id, repeat_after/repeat_mode, labels (array)
Pagination headers x-pagination-total-pages and x-pagination-result-count exposed via access-control-expose-headers; 21 undone tasks and 44 done tasks as of probe date

14 projects in this Vikunja instance: Inbox(1) Everyday(2) Someday(4) Personal Growth(5) Business Acquisition(6) CT-90day(7) Health(8) Intentional(9) Metal Casework(10) Goals(11) Research(12) Habits(13) Inbox/felix-bot(14). Each has 4 default views with filter fields.
Server-side filter done=false is accepted and returns undone tasks (HTTP 200)
Server-side filter done=true is accepted and returns done tasks (HTTP 200)
Server-side filter due_date < now accepted; date math with now anchor works (HTTP 200)
Server-side filter project_id=13 accepted; numeric equality on project_id works (HTTP 200)

column4: No batch-read endpoint: GET /tasks/bulk returns HTTP 400 (parsed as GET /tasks/{id} with id=bulk). Read access must use GET /tasks/all pagination or GET /tasks/{id} per-task.

GET /tasks/all?updated_since=<ISO> is accepted and returns only tasks updated after the given timestamp; this is the primary delta-polling mechanism

column4: Filter language supports: boolean equality/inequality, numeric comparisons, date math (now/d now-7d), combined AND. Labels filter requires numeric IDs. saved views per project carry filter expressions.
habits/record_completion.py: three-write transaction — POST /tasks/<id> {done:true} + PUT /tasks/<id>/comments + JSONL append. Idempotent on task_id+date+state. HTTP client: urllib.request.
habits/reconcile_completions.py: reads GET /projects + GET /projects/<id>/tasks; client-side filter (G7 workaround); detects done=true with no JSONL entry and backfills with source=vikunja-ui.
habits/set_due_dates.py: reads GET /projects + GET /projects/<id>/tasks; writes POST /tasks/{id} with updated due_date. Two URL bases: Tailscale HTTPS in some scripts vs direct IP HTTP in others.
habits/sweeper.py: writes POST /tasks/{id} with due_date update on completion/reschedule events. Vikunja v0.24.6 partial update uses POST not PATCH/PUT.
escalation/record_completion.py: writes PATCH /tasks/{id} with done=true (for done state) or updated due_date (for rescheduled). Unlike habits, escalation uses PATCH not POST for task updates.
enrichment/record_completion.py: writes only PUT /tasks/{id}/comments (enrichment state comment). Does not PATCH task fields — comment-only write-path.
security/credential_health_check/vikunja_writer.py: reads GET /projects for inbox lookup; writes PUT /projects/{id}/tasks to create alert task. Different base URL pattern (Tailscale HTTPS constant).

Signal pipeline uses LogCursor dataclass (path/inode/byte_offset/mtime) as freshness pointer and SignalExtraction (signal_id/count_cycle/count_rolling/excerpts/last_event_at_utc/new_cursor) as extraction result. Pattern maps to sync architecture reconciliation cycle.

Doc-auditor driver writes last-tick.json to /data/services/openclaw/felix-doc-auditor-driver/last-tick.json after every tick (success or failure). Shape: {status, timestamp_utc, errors, next_tick_utc, judgment}. Directly reusable as health signal pattern for sync driver.

habits/schedule_loader.py is a pure-read config loader (no Vikunja API calls). Returns typed ScheduleEntry dataclasses from YAML. is_active_today() is deterministic. Not directly reusable for sync (entity list is static not dynamic).

habits-history.jsonl live format confirmed: {domain, task_id (int Vikunja id), title, date (for), state, source, note, timestamp (recorded)}. Append-only. Per-domain files under /data/services/openclaw/state/.

Two Vikunja base URL values in use across production scripts: https://office2.tail0f5f56.ts.net/api/v1 (HTTPS Tailscale) and http://100.92.197.90:3456/api/v1 (direct IP HTTP). Inconsistency is a latent fragility that sync architecture normalization should address.
